day6_intro.speaker: The Boss
day6_intro.text: So you're the one Tane's been dealing with. Nice little operation you got here.

boss_identity.speaker: The Boss
boss_identity.text: Names don't matter. What matters is you've been moving our product. Tane's been... detained. So now you deal with me directly.

boss_demand.speaker: The Boss
boss_demand.text: Simple. You keep selling our gear, we keep you in business. Stop selling... and well, this nice shop of yours might have some unfortunate accidents.

tane_fate.speaker: The Boss
tane_fate.text: Police got him. Too sloppy. You don't want to be sloppy. Now, are you in or out?

want_out.speaker: The Boss
want_out.text: There's no 'out'. Not after you've moved our product. You're part of this now. Make your choice.

comply.speaker: The Boss
comply.text: Smart choice. We'll have more product for you tomorrow. Don't disappoint me.

defy.speaker: The Boss
defy.text: Wrong answer. Remember this moment when your shop's in pieces tomorrow night.

day7_finale.speaker: The Boss
day7_finale.text: Final day. Time to settle up. You've been useful... for the most part.

final_demand.speaker: The Boss
final_demand.text: Now you keep quiet. We're moving operations. If you talk to the cops, we'll know. And we'll be back.

demand_payment.speaker: The Boss
demand_payment.text: Your cut? You're still breathing, that's your cut. Take it and be grateful.

gang_ending.speaker: The Boss
gang_ending.text: Good doing business with you. Stay out of trouble... and we'll stay out of yours.

betray_ending.speaker: The Boss
betray_ending.text: Big mistake. Boys... trash the place.

day7_ramraid.speaker: The Boss
day7_ramraid.text: Should have taken the deal when you had the chance. Say goodbye to your shop.
